A [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''tentacled creatures''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kelrodo-Ai/Legends|Kelrodo-Ai]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The creatures, which were [[Color/Legends|pink]] and red in color, lived in tunnels and laid gelatinous black [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] which they violently protected from intruders. The creatures were sensitive to movement and more likely to attack fast-moving targets.
